glosses: leżeć z uniesioną częścią tułowia, podpierając się o jakiś przedmiot

examples.text: Na otomance półleżała rozkapryszona birbantka, paląc cygaro.

glosses: To cause to lean back; to bend back.
To put in a resting position.

examples.text: She reclined her arms on the table and sighed.
The mother, lovely tho' with grief oppreſt, / Reclin'd his dying head upon her breaſt.

glosses: To put oneself in a resting position.
A mechanism for lowering the back of a seat to support a less upright position; Also, the action of lowering the back using such a mechanism.

examples.text: To gain a little more space, airlines are turning to a new generation of seats that use lighter materials and less padding, moving the magazine pocket above the tray table and even reducing or eliminating the recline in seats.
